items.title: Cloudflare Measures Origin TLS Preferences, Cutting Handshake Retries from 52% to 3.7%
items.blurb: Cloudflare has replaced its static X25519 guess for origin TLS handshakes with per-origin measurement. HelloRetryRequests on scanned origins fell from roughly 52% to 3.7%, removing over 150 ms from p90 latency.
